'''Eldar Salayev''' ({{langx|az|Eldar Yunis oğlu Salayev}}; 31 December 1933 – 20 June 2022) was an Azerbaijani physicist. He was President of the [[Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences]] from 1983 to 1997.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://science.gov.az/ru/forms/byivshie-prezidentyi/173|title=Салаев Эльдар Юнис оглы|work=Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences|language=Russian}}</ref>

==Biography==
From 1970 to 1973, Salayev was deputy director of Scientific Affairs at the [[Institute of Physics Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences]]. In 1972, he received the {{ill|State Prize of the Azerbaijan SSR|az|Azərbaycan SSR Dövlət mükafatı}}.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://science.gov.az/az/forms/byivshie-prezidentyi/173|title=Salayev Eldar Yunis oğlu|work=Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences|language=Azerbaijani}}</ref>

Eldar Salayev died on 20 June 2022 at the age of 88.<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=21 June 2022|title=AMEA-nın sabiq prezidenti dəfn edildi Fotolar|trans-title= |url=https://www.azerbaycan24.com/amea-nin-sabiq-prezidenti-defn-edildi-fotolar/|language=Azerbaijani|work=Azərbaycan24|location= |access-date=21 June 2022}}</ref>
